parsed.explanation: Thin dossier; extrapolating from structural signals. Positives: no sodomy offence ever, no trans-specific criminal law, no documented police targeting, raids, or violence against gender-diverse people, and a mild positive signal of trans people appearing openly in traditional/ceremonial roles. Negatives: no anti-discrimination law, state censorship of LGBT webpages and social-media retraction campaigns (state threat-ambient rather than trans-specific), state tolerance conditioned on staying unobtrusive — an 'immodesty' morality lever that could in principle be applied to visibly trans visitors, though no documented instance is cited. Societal discrimination described as prevalent, but dated (2013, 2000) and LGB-framed. No visitor-facing universal exposures, no custody or facility rules documented. This sits below the 0.65-C anchor (which documents established gender-diverse community roles and working recourse) but clearly above high-risk tiers: worst documented feature is tier-3-at-most, weakly evidenced, and mainly latent. 0.62.
